title: Rajraani header: choose the visual world
question: For the announcement strip and top bar. The roll assigned The Haveli Gateway. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Haveli Gateway
options.lineage: Banaras havelis: carved lintels, lime walls, brass-studded doors
options.thesis: Arriving at Rajraani is stepping through a haveli door: a lacquered lintel, a lime wall, brass studs on the door.
options.viewport: A thin sindoor-lacquer lintel carries one engraved message; below it a lime-white wall with the house line set like a doorway plaque, and the five actions as small brass studs.
options.risk: Becomes theme-park if the lintel is carved or ornamented; it must stay a flat band of colour and metal.

raised.raise: Two inks only, indigo and sindoor, on lime white; brass appears only as metal (rules and rings), never as fill.
The announcement changes by one short roll upward and settles, like a blind stepping one course; no fades, no tickers.
State is a mark, not a colour: the active or hovered action gains a brass ring, it does not change hue.
Fixed regions: lintel, wall and studs never move or resize between pages; only their contents change.

options.label: The Saree Box
options.lineage: Banarasi saree boxes: dyed card, gold-foil stamping, tissue
options.thesis: The header is the lid of a Rajraani box: one deep colour, the name foil-stamped, opened by the visitor.
options.viewport: Announcement and top bar merge into one aubergine lid band with foil-gold type and icons, a single tissue-white edge beneath.
options.risk: Closest to the dark-and-gold look most heritage sites ship, and to the brocade bar you already turned down.

options.label: Kinari Border
options.lineage: fused from a Secession folk-flower page: the saree's own border
options.thesis: The header is edged like a saree: a woven kinari grows in from both margins and stops where the words begin.
options.viewport: A plain bar whose lower edge carries a narrow kinari that draws in from left and right once on load, leaving the middle clear.
options.case: Buyers know a kinari instantly (strong identification), but ornament competes with the cloth the site is selling.
options.risk: Ornament on chrome is the brocade bar again in a different stitch.

options.label: Azulejo Hall
options.thesis: Cobalt narrative panels on milk-white tile.
options.viewport: A tiled lintel band painted in cobalt.
options.case: Portuguese, not Banarasi; buyers would not recognise it as theirs.

options.label: Depot Blind
options.thesis: Messages on a roll of cloth stepping under a window.
options.viewport: The strip as a stepping cloth blind.
options.case: A transit object; no link to heritage textile buyers.
options.kept: The one-course step as the only motion.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: A perforated rail with marked frames.
options.viewport: A rail of frames across the header.
options.case: Editing-room language; meaningless to a bride or collector.
options.kept: State shown by a mark rather than a colour change.

options.label: Sixteen-Colour Screen
options.thesis: Dithered pixel artwork in fixed regions.
options.case: Retro computing; contradicts a five-figure handloom piece.
options.kept: Regions that never move between pages.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud
options.thesis: White field with a hairline spectral edge.
options.viewport: A white bar with a pastel hairline.
options.case: Weather science; no tie to Banaras or cloth.
options.kept: Colour confined to one hairline edge.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What luxury fashion headers ship: a slim plain bar, black icons, nothing else.
canonCard.viewport: A white bar, one line of small text, five black icons, a hairline.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other fashion site by design.
